ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

fields.topology_type: Point-to-point host-master / card-slave bus on a 9-pin (SD) or 4-pin (SPI) connector. Modern consumer SD / microSD slots are exclusively single-host / single-card.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + single removable card
supported_topologies.description: Standard SD / microSD slot — most common.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + embedded SD (eSD)
supported_topologies.description: Soldered-down SD; no mechanical card-detect; same protocol.

supported_topologies.name: Legacy SD multi-card bus
supported_topologies.description: Historical SD spec allowed multiple cards on the same CLK/CMD/DAT3..DAT0 with unique RCAs after CMD3; modern consumer hosts almost never use this configuration.

supported_topologies.name: SPI mode single-card
supported_topologies.description: CLK + CS + DI + DO; CS-selected single peripheral.

supported_topologies.name: UHS-II differential lanes
supported_topologies.description: Separate back-side pin row with differential lane pair; out of scope of this 9-pin pad assignment.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Generates CLK; issues all commands; controls bus mode (1-bit / 4-bit / SPI), voltage (3.3 V / 1.8 V), and clock rate.
Responds to commands on CMD; sources/sinks data on DAT; signals busy via DAT0 LOW.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge). The bus is a flat 1-host : N-card bus; addressing is by RCA on the CMD line after CMD3.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_block: Bits transmitted MSB-first per byte on DAT line(s); receiver reassembles in same order.
ordering_guarantees.across_blocks: Strictly sequential block order on multi-block read/write; no reordering. With Command Queueing (v6.00+), queued tasks may complete out-of-order but data within a single task is in-order.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: The card exposes a single linear LBA address space (byte-addressable for SDSC, block-addressable in 512-B units for SDHC/SDXC). No memory-mapped peripheral regions are exposed on the bus.

device_classification.removable_card: Standard SD / microSD / miniSD — mechanical insert / remove.
device_classification.embedded_card_eSD: Soldered SD package — no mechanical card-detect.
device_classification.host_controller: SDHCI-compliant host controller IP integrated into the SoC.
device_classification.card_reader: USB / PCIe → SD bridge — appears as a host to the card and as a mass-storage device to the upstream bus.
